High Protein Cheesy Chicken Alfredo Rolls🍗🧀🌯 65g Protein Meal Prep💪🏼 (Macros: Per Roll - 10 Total) 438 Calories 25gC | 13gF | 65gP Want more recipes like this? check out my high protein cook books with over 300 recipes 👨🏻‍🍳📚 Ingredients:  1.7KG Boneless & Skinless Chicken Breast (raw weight) 1 Tsp Smoked Paprika, 1 Tsp Onion Powder, 1 Tsp Garlic Powder, 1 Tsp Salt 1 Tsp Olive Oil 1 Large Diced Brown Onion 4 Diced Garlic Cloves 450g Low Fat Cottage Cheese 35g Grated Parmesan Cheese 100ml Low Fat Milk 2 Tsp Italian Herb Seasoning, 1/2 Tsp Black Pepper, 1/2 Tsp Salt 60g Light Cream Cheese 10 Warm Tortillas (Mission Carb Balance Tortillas) 40g Light Mozzarella (per roll - 10 total) Egg Wash or Light Cooking Oil Spray Topping: Grated Parmesan Cheese & Parsley Flakes Instructions: 1. Place on a lined baking tray. Brush with egg wash or spray with oil, then top with parmesan & parsley flakes. 8. Bake at 190°C/375°F for 8 – 12 mins or until golden brown & crispy. #chicken #alfredo #highprotein #healthyrecipes #mealprep

Creamy Cajun Chicken 🔥 Ingredients For the chicken: * Chicken breasts * Salt * Black pepper * Garlic powder * Cajun seasoning For the Cajun sauce: * Butter * Chopped onion * Cherry tomatoes * Red bell pepper * Minced garlic * Tomato paste * Salt & black pepper * Thyme * Oregano * Cajun seasoning * Chicken broth * Heavy cream Cooking Instructions 1. Season the chicken: Pat the chicken breasts dry and season both sides with salt, black pepper, garlic powder, and Cajun seasoning. 2. Cook the chicken: Heat a little oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat. Sear the chicken on both sides until golden brown and fully cooked (165°F internal temperature). Remove from the skillet and set aside. 3. Prepare the sauce: In the same skillet, melt the butter. Add the chopped onion, red bell pepper and cherry tomatoes. Sauté until softened. 4. Add the aromatics: Stir in the minced garlic and tomato paste. Cook for about 1 minute. 5. Season the sauce: Add salt, black pepper, thyme, oregano and Cajun seasoning. Stir everything together. 6. Make it creamy: Pour in the chicken broth and heavy cream. Stir well and let the sauce simmer until it thickens slightly. 7. Bring it all together: Return the chicken to the skillet and spoon the creamy Cajun sauce over the chicken. Let everything simmer together for a few minutes so the flavors come together. 8. Serve: Garnish with fresh parsley if desired. Serve warm over rice, mashed potatoes, or pasta. 🤍 Enjoy your Creamy Cajun Chicken! #CreamyCajunChicken #CajunCooking #ChickenRecipes  #creatorsearchinsights #recipestocook

DUMP & BAKE SMOTHERED CHICKEN DINNER 🍗🤎 The kind of dinner that tastes like you spent all day in the kitchen, but really you just threw everything in a baking dish and let the oven do the work! Tender, juicy chicken smothered in homemade gravy with hardly any effort. Serve it over mashed potatoes or rice with your favorite sides and you’ve got yourself a good home-cooked meal! RECIPE BELOW ⬇️ Ingredients: 2 lbs boneless, skinless chicken thighs Olive oil Salt & pepper Garlic powder Onion powder Paprika Cajun seasoning (optional, for a little kick) 1 sprig fresh rosemary 2 tbsp butter 2 cups chicken broth Carrots or your favorite veggies 2 tbsp cornstarch + 2 tbsp water (use 3 tbsp of each for a thicker gravy) Directions: 1. Preheat oven to 350°F. Add chicken thighs and carrots to a baking dish. Drizzle with olive oil and season generously with salt, pepper, garlic powder, onion powder, paprika, and Cajun seasoning if using. Don’t be shy with the seasonings! This is where all your flavor comes from, so eyeball it and season heavily. 2. Add rosemary, butter, and chicken broth. Cover tightly with foil and bake at 350°F for approximately 50 minutes. 3. Remove from oven and carefully pour just the broth into a separate bowl or measuring cup. 4. Mix 2 tbsp cornstarch with 2 tbsp cold water to make a slurry. If you prefer a thicker gravy, use 3 tbsp cornstarch and 3 tbsp water instead. Stir the slurry into the hot broth until well combined, then pour everything back over the chicken and veggies. 5. Return to the oven uncovered at 400°F for approximately 20 minutes, or until the gravy has thickened and the chicken is tender and fully cooked (165°F internally). Serve over creamy mashed potatoes or rice with green beans, a warm dinner roll, or whatever your heart desires! That’s the beauty of cooking. Make it how YOU like it! 🤎 Save this one for an easy, comforting weeknight dinner! #easymeal #easyrecipe #momlife #fallvibes #smotheredchicken

Lasagna (No Pasta Noodles!) 🧅 A little twist on traditional lasagna! Instead of pasta noodles, we’re using tender onion layers, savory meat sauce, and a creamy Boursin cheese filling. I wasn’t sure how this would turn out, but it was SO good! Ingredients Onion layers * 3 large yellow onions Meat sauce * 1 lb lean ground beef * 3–4 cloves garlic, minced * 2 tbsp tomato paste * 1 jar Yo Mamas Foods marinara sauce * 1 tsp Italian seasoning * 1 tsp garlic powder * 1 tsp onion powder * ½ tsp smoked paprika * Salt and black pepper, to taste Creamy cheese filling * 1 (5.2 oz) package Boursin Garlic & Fine Herbs * ¼ cup plain Greek yogurt * ¼ cup grated Parmesan * ½ cup shredded mozzarella * 1 egg For layering * Additional shredded mozzarella * Parmesan cheese Instructions 1. Trim both ends of the onions and remove the outer skin. Boil the onions whole in a large pot of water for approximately 20–25 minutes, or until tender enough for the layers to separate easily without falling apart. 2. Drain and let the onions cool for about 30 minutes. Gently separate the layers. 3. Brown the ground beef in a skillet. Add minced garlic, tomato paste, marinara, and seasonings. Stir and let simmer until the sauce thickens. 4. In a bowl, mix Boursin, Greek yogurt, Parmesan, mozzarella, and egg until creamy. 5. In a baking dish, layer meat sauce, onion layers, creamy cheese filling, and mozzarella. Repeat until your dish is filled. 6. Finish with meat sauce, mozzarella, and Parmesan. 7. Bake uncovered at 375°F for 15–20 minutes, until hot and bubbly. Broil for 1–2 minutes if you’d like a golden cheese topping. 8. Let rest before slicing and serving. And that’s it! A fun little twist on lasagna that you have to try. 🤍 Save this recipe for your next dinner night! @Yo Mama's Foods @Boursin Cheese  #OnionLasagna #DinnerIdeas #LasagnaRecipe #HomeCooking #EasyDinner

Sheet Pan Garlic Parmesan Chicken and Potatoes 🧄🧈 For ALL of you asking about the app, search “Osta” on the app or Google play store 🫶 Minimal effort, maximum flavor… juicy chicken, crispy potatoes covered in garlicky parmesan butter perfection 🔥 For the potatoes: - 1.5 lbs (680 g) baby potatoes - 1/3 cup butter, melted - 1 cup parmesan cheese - 8 garlic cloves, minced - Seasonings: 2 tsp each of paprika, oregano, garlic powder, salt, black pepper - 3 tbsp olive oil For the chicken: - 6 to 8 chicken thighs, boneless & skinless - Seasonings: 1 tbsp seasoning salt, 1 tbsp paprika, 2 tsp garlic powder, 2 tsp onion powder, 2 tsp italian seasoning, 1 tsp cumin - 1 lemon, juiced - 2 tbsp mayonnaise For the garlic & onion: - 2 garlic heads + 2 tbsp olive oil + 2 tsp salt - 1 red onion, cut into chunks + olive oil, drizzled For the Aioli:  - 1/3 cup greek yogurt + 1/3 cup mayonnaise - 2 roasted garlic heads - 1/4 lemon, juiced - 2 tsp black pepper + 1 tsp salt - 3 tbsp chives, chopped For the Baste (optional ): - 1/4 cup mayonnaise  - 1/4 cup parmesan  - 2 tsp paprika Instructions: 1. In a bowl, combine the chicken, seasonings, lemon juice, garlic, and mayonnaise. Mix well and marinate for as long as you wish (up to overnight). 2. Preheat your oven to 375°F (190°C). Add the potatoes to a large casserole dish. Toss with the melted butter, parmesan, olive oil, garlic, and seasonings. Spread evenly. 3. Top with the chicken thighs. Add the red onion chunks around the dish & drizzle them with olive oil.  4. Slice the tops off the garlic heads, drizzle with olive oil and salt, wrap in foil, & place in dish. 5. Bake for 40 mins. Broil for the last 2–3 mins if desired.  6. Optional but recommended: Mix together mayo, parmesan, and paprika. At the 20-min mark, baste the chicken & return to the oven. 7. In a bowl, combine the yogurt, mayo, lemon juice, salt, pepper, and chives. Squeeze in as much of the roasted garlic as you wish OR chop them up first. Mix. 8. Finish with fresh parm, chives, & lemon slices. Enjoy! #recipe #cookingathometiktoktv #dinner #recipesoftiktok #dinnerideas

videos.caption: VIRAL BROTHY BEEF BOWLS 🔥 If you love soup recipes, but want something substantial and super filling, these are one of the best easy weeknight meals. It’s so easy to make, so good, and packed with protei and flavor. These are super filling and come in under 500 calories and 35g protein a bowl. One of my favorite protein hacks is using a really good bone broth.That little Kettle & Fire carton has almost 20g of protein on its own, I used up a cup in the broth, and a cup making the rice instead of water to boost the protein + flavor. Here is how I made it: 1️⃣ Start with 1 lb ground beef in a large pan over medium-high heat. Break it apart as it browns, then add 4 minced garlic cloves, 1 tbsp smoked paprika, 1/4 tsp cayenne pepper, 1/4 tsp red chili flakes, and a generous pinch of salt. Brown it up really well. 2️⃣ For the broth, add 2.5 tbsp red curry paste and 2 minced garlic cloves to a saucepan over medium heat. Stir for 1-2 mins until softened and fragrant. 3️⃣ Pour in 3/4 cup half-and-half (or coconut milk) and 1 cup Kettle & Fire bone broth. Stir everything together until smooth and bring to a gentle simmer. 4️⃣ Season the broth with a generous couple pinches salt, fresh lime juice, and freshly chopped cilantro. Taste and adjust to your liking. You want it creamy, savory, a little spicy, and bright from the lime. 5️⃣ For the quick pickled red onions, super thinly slice 1/2 large red onion and add it to a bowl. Add juice of 1 lemon and sprinkle with sea salt. Mix really well with a fork and let sit 5-10 mins to soften. 6️⃣ Prepare 4 servings rice of choice. I love replacing the water in mine with bone broth for extra flavor + protein. 7️⃣ To assemble, add 3/4 cup cooked rice to a bowl, add 1/4 of the seasoned beef, and ladle 1/4 of the broth over everything. 8️⃣ Top with thinly sliced cucumbers, quick pickled red onions, sesame seeds, Korean chili flakes and plenty of finely chopped fresh cilantro. If you make it, let me know what you think on SHREDHAPPENS! ENJOY! 🙌 #healthyrecipes #healthyfoodshare #goodmoodfood

Sticky Chicken & Garlic Noodles  This is an  easy weeknight dinner you can make with spaghetti or ramen noodles. I got this from my friend @mamasdownsouthkitchen 😊 Ingredients Chicken and vegetables: 1½ lbs boneless, skinless chicken thighs, diced 1 tsp garlic powder 1 tsp onion powder ½ tsp black pepper 1 tbsp chili crunch (optional)  1 tsp sesame oil  2 tbsp oil (for cooking)  2 bell peppers, diced 1 onion, diced Sticky garlic sauce: ½ cup soy sauce (used reduced if you are sensitive to salt)  2 tbsp minced garlic ¼ cup honey 3 tbsp hoisin sauce 2 tbsp cornstarch Noodles: 12 oz spaghetti or 4–5 packs of ramen noodles, seasoning packets discarded Up to 1 cup reserved noodle cooking water Instructions 1. Toss the diced chicken with the garlic powder, onion powder, black pepper, sesame oil, and chili crunch. Set a pot of water on the stove to boil. 2. Heat olive oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat. Add the seasoned chicken and let it sear. 3. While the chicken sears, whisk together the soy sauce, honey, hoisin sauce, minced garlic, and cornstarch until smooth. 4. Add the diced bell peppers and onion to the skillet. Cook, stirring occasionally, until the vegetables begin to soften and the chicken is cooked through. 5. Cook the noodles according to the package directions. Reserve some of the cooking water before draining. 6. Stir the minced garlic into the skillet and cook for about 1 minute, until fragrant. Give the sauce another whisk, pour it into the skillet, and stir until it bubbles and thickens. Add the reserved noodle water a splash at a time until the sauce reaches your desired consistency. 7. Add the drained noodles to the skillet and toss until everything is coated in the sticky garlic sauce. Serve warm and enjoy! #easyrecipe #easydinner #dinnerideas #onepotmeals #chickenrecipe

Ingredients: •1 Pound Flank Steak, sliced into thin strips •1 Red Bell Pepper, chopped •1 Green Bell Pepper, chopped •1 Medium Yellow Onion, chopped •Pinch of Salt, for vegetables •2 Tablespoons Avocado Oil, or neutral oil of choice, to cook steak & vegetables Steak Marinade: • 2 Tablespoons Low-Sodium Soy Sauce • 4 Cloves Garlic, minced • 1 Tablespoon Avocado Oil, or neutral cooking oil of choice • 2 Teaspoons reduced-sodium Rice Vinegar •1½ Teaspoons Cornstarch •½ Teaspoon Black Pepper •½ Teaspoon Granulated White sugar, or brown sugar •½ Teaspoon Baking Soda Sauce: •½ Cup Low-Sodium Soy Sauce •2 Tablespoons Beef Stock, or unsalted beef stock •2 Tablespoons reduced-sodium Rice Vinegar •1½ Tablespoon Granulated White Sugar, or brown sugar •2 Teaspoons Cornstarch •¼ Teaspoon Black Pepper •(optional) 2 Tablespoons of water, to dilute if too salty for your taste Instructions: 1. Pat steak dry. Thinly slice flank steak against the grain into about ¼-inch strips. Add steak into a medium-sized bowl. 2. For the steak marinade, toss the steak in soy sauce, minced garlic, oil, rice vinegar, cornstarch, black pepper, sugar, and baking soda. Mix well and fully coat the steak in the marinade. Cover the bowl and refrigerate for at least 15 minutes, up to 1 hour. 3. To make the sauce, in a separate medium-sized bowl add in soy sauce, beef stock, rice vinegar, sugar, cornstarch, and black pepper. Mix and whisk together ingredients well. Set aside. 4. When ready to cook, heat a large skillet to medium-high heat. Add in 2 tbsp cooking oil. Once oil is hot, shimmers and easily moves around the skillet, add steak to the skillet in batches. Be sure not to overcrowd the skillet. Sear steak for about 1 minute to brown and then flip over to continue cooking for an additional 1 minute to brown. Remove from the skillet and repeat until all of the steak is cooked. 5. Once done cooking the steak, reduce heat to medium, add in more oil if necessary, then toss in chopped onion and chopped bell peppers. Sprinkle with a pinch of salt and saute for a couple of minutes until onions and peppers are slightly softened. 6. Next, pour the sauce into the skillet, stir and simmer for a few minutes until the sauce thickens. Then, toss the steak into the skillet and mix well until all ingredients are combined and the steak is reheated. Serve and enjoy.

french dip sandwiches on garlic butter pretzel buns ✨ Ingredients  Beef/Au Jus - 3 lbs chuck roast - 2 tsp onion powder (for beef) - 2 tsp garlic powder (for beef) - Salt and pepper, generously  - 5 cups beef stock - 6 garlic cloves - 3 rosemary sprigs  - 2 yellow onions, sliced - 2 tbsp Worcestershire sauce  - 1 tbsp roasted beef bouillon paste - 1 1/2 tsp onion powder  - 1 tsp garlic powder  - 1/4 tsp msg (optional) - Salt to taste  - Avocado oil, for searing Caramelized onions  - 5 yellow onions, sliced  - 1 tbsp butter  - 1 tbsp neutral oil - 2 tsp granulated sugar  - Salt to taste Roasted garlic horse radish aoii - 1/2 cup mayonnaise - 1 whole head roasted garlic - 1–1 1/2 tbsp prepared horseradish (adjust to taste) - 1 tsp Dijon mustard - 1 tsp lemon juice - 1/2 tsp Worcestershire sauce - 1/4 tsp black pepper - Salt to taste Extras - Pretzel buns  - Garlic butter  - Provolone Cheese  Instructions - Pat the chuck roast dry and generously season all sides with salt, pepper, onion powder, and garlic powder. - Heat avocado oil in a large Dutch oven over medium-high heat. Sear the beef on all sides until deeply browned.Remove and set aside. - the same pot, add the sliced onions and cook until softened, scraping up the browned bits from the bottom. - Add the onion powder, garlic powder, salt, and pepper. Stir until fragrant. - Pour in the beef stock and stir, scraping the bottom of the pot to release all the flavor. - Add Worcestershire sauce, roasted beef bouillon paste, garlic cloves, and rosemary. Stir to combine. - Return the seared chuck roast to the pot. Bring to a gentle simmer, then cover and cook on low heat forapproximately 4 hours, turning the beef occasionally, until fork-tender and easily shreddable. - Remove the beef and shred with two forks. Strain the cooking liquid and reserve for dipping. Skim excess fat and adjust seasoning to taste. - Heat butter and neutral oil in a skillet over medium-low heat. - Add sliced onions, sugar and a generous pinch of salt. Cook slowly, stirring occasionally,for 35–45 minutes until deeply golden and caramelized. - Slice the pretzel buns and brush the insides with garlic butter. - Toast in a skillet until golden. - Spread roasted garlic horseradish aioli on the buns. Pile on the shredded beef, caramelized onions, and provolone cheese. Broil or cover briefly until the cheese is melted and bubbly. - Serve warm with the reserved beef au jus for dipping. • • • #recipes #recipeideas #fallrecipes #DinnerIdeas

If you need an easy dinner idea tonight, make these sheet pan chicken fajitas.  One of the easiest dinners ever, so flavorful, so delicious, and dinner is on the table in about 30 minutes. Everyone loved it. Ingredients: •4 medium chicken breasts sliced into thin strips (or boneless skinless chicken thighs) •1 large onion sliced •1 green pepper sliced •1 red pepper sliced •1 yellow pepper sliced •¼–⅓ cup olive oil or avocado oil •2–3 tsp salt •1 tsp black pepper •1 tbsp paprika •2 tsp cumin powder •2 tsp garlic powder Homemade Guacamole: •3 ripe avocados •½ onion finely chopped •1 Serrano chili (optional) •½ bunch cilantro chopped •Juice from 2 limes •Salt to taste •Tortillas of choice Instructions: Slice the chicken into thin strips and add directly onto a sheet pan. I skipped parchment paper because I wanted the chicken and vegetables to get direct heat from the pan for extra flavor and color. Slice the onion and peppers into strips and add them to the pan. Season with all the spices, drizzle with oil, and toss everything together really well. Spread into an even layer and bake in a preheated 425°F oven for 20–25 minutes. Meanwhile, prepare the guacamole. Mash the avocados and mix with the onion, Serrano chili, cilantro, lime juice, and salt. Give the chicken and vegetables a quick toss, then broil for another 2–3 minutes until slightly charred. Serve in warm tortillas with fresh guacamole, cilantro, and an extra squeeze of lime. #sivanskitchen #sheetpan #fajita #chicken #easyrecipe

I didn’t measure my seasonings, just added everything to taste! Garlic Butter Beef Linguine with Creamy Parmesan Cheddar Sauce 🥩🧄🧀🍝 This Garlic Butter Beef Linguine is creamy, cheesy, and packed with rich garlic butter flavor. Tender seasoned ground beef is tossed with linguine in a silky Parmesan cheddar sauce for an easy, comforting dinner everyone will love. Ingredients * 12 oz linguine * 1 lb lean ground beef * 1 tbsp olive oil * 3 tbsp butter * 4 cloves garlic, minced * 1 cup heavy cream * 1/2 cup beef broth * 1 cup shredded sharp cheddar cheese * 1/2 cup grated Parmesan cheese * 1 tsp Italian seasoning * 1/2 tsp crushed red pepper flakes (optional) * 1/2 tsp garlic powder * Salt and black pepper, to taste * 2 tbsp chopped fresh parsley Instructions 1. Cook the linguine according to the package directions until al dente. Reserve 1/2 cup of the pasta water, then drain. 2. Heat the olive oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat. Add the ground beef and cook until browned, breaking it apart as it cooks. Drain excess grease if needed. 3. Add the butter and minced garlic. Cook for 30 seconds until fragrant. 4. Pour in the beef broth and heavy cream. Stir well and simmer for 3–4 minutes. 5. Add the cheddar cheese and Parmesan cheese, stirring until completely melted and smooth. 6. Season with Italian seasoning, garlic powder, crushed red pepper flakes, salt, and black pepper. 7. Add the cooked linguine to the skillet and toss until every strand is coated in the creamy sauce. Add a splash of reserved pasta water if needed. 8. Sprinkle with fresh parsley and serve immediately. Serving Suggestions Serve with garlic bread, Caesar salad, roasted broccoli, or sautéed green beans. Storage Store leftovers in an airtight container in the refrigerator for up to 3 days. Reheat gently with a splash of milk or cream. Time * Prep Time: 10 minutes * Cook Time: 20 minutes * Total Time: 30 minutes Servings: 4–6 Save this recipe and follow for more easy comfort food recipes! ❤️ #GarlicButterBeef #CreamyPasta #Linguine #GroundBeefRecipes #EasyDinner

This is dinner on easy mode! 🍲 Stick of Butter Chicken and Rice will be your best friend in the kitchen when you don’t feel like spending hours over the stovetop! Want to make it later? Save this recipe in @myrecipes so it's ready when you are. Ingredients: 2 cups white rice 1 (10.5-ounces) can condensed French onion soup 2 (10.5 ounce) cans condensed beef consomme 8 ounces baby portobello mushrooms, roughly chopped 1 cup grated Pecorino Romano or Parmesan cheese, divided 1 stick butter, cut into 8 pieces 2 pounds boneless skinless chicken thighs 1 1/4 teaspoons kosher salt 3/4 teaspoon freshly ground black pepper 1 teaspoon garlic powder 1 teaspoon onion powder 1 teaspoon paprika 1 tablespoon chopped parsley (optional) Directions: Preheat the oven to 350 degrees F (175 degrees C). Stir rice, French onion soup, beef consomme, and portobello mushrooms together in a 9 x 13-inch baking dish. Top with 3/4 cup of the cheese and add butter pieces on top. Season chicken evenly with salt, pepper, garlic powder, onion powder, and paprika and place on top of cheese and butter. Top with remaining cheese and cover dish with foil. Bake in the preheated oven for 45 minutes. Uncover and bake until top is golden brown, liquid has been absorbed into the rice, and chicken is cooked through, about 20 more minutes. Sprinkle with fresh parsley if desired. Inspiration: @melissajorealrecipes 🧑‍🍳: @nicolemcmom #easydinners #dinnerideas #butter #chicken #chickenandrice

This recipe went VIRAL for a reason… and I’m convinced it’s the BEST Sunday dinner you’ll ever make! 🤤👏🏼 I’ve made these slow-roasted chicken thighs for 9 Sundays in a row, and my family STILL isn’t tired of them! 😂 Perfectly seasoned, melt-in-your-mouth tender, and packed with SO much flavor! It’s one of those meals that looks impressive but is ridiculously easy to make! Ingredients: • Boneless chicken thighs • Salt & pepper • Garlic powder • Paprika • Italian seasoning • Olive oil • 1 sliced onion (I use less!) • 2 cups chicken broth • Fresh thyme • Cornstarch + cold water (for gravy) Directions: 1. Place chicken thighs in a baking dish and generously season both sides with salt, pepper, garlic powder, paprika & Italian seasoning. 2. Drizzle with olive oil and add sliced onions. 3. Pour in 2 cups of chicken broth and add fresh thyme. 4. Cover and bake at 350°F for 1 hour. 5. Remove thyme and pour the cooking liquid into a separate bowl. Mix cornstarch with cold water to make a slurry, then stir into the liquid. 6. Pour the gravy mixture back over the chicken. 7. Bake UNCOVERED at 450°F for another 30 minutes, until the chicken is beautifully browned and the gravy thickens!  And YES, I promise the broth doesn’t wash off all that seasoning. 😂 Just trust the process! All credit to @allyssainthekitchen for this incredible recipe! 🤎 SAVE THIS ONE because I promise you’ll be making it again and again! #SundayDinner #ChickenThighs #EasyDinnerIdeas #HomeCooking #DinnerRecipes

One Pan Garlic Parmesan Chicken Bake🔥410 cals 37g protein 11g fat 40g carbs Cookbook in bio 🔗 Ingredients: this makes 6 meals 1.5 lbs boneless, skinless chicken thighs, cut into bite-sized pieces 1 ½ cups jasmine rice, uncooked 3 cups chicken broth, warmed 1 medium yellow onion, diced 1 red bell pepper, diced 1 ½ cups cherry tomatoes, halved 2 cups baby spinach, roughly chopped 4 cloves garlic, minced 50g freshly grated Parmesan cheese 2 tsp Italian seasoning 1 ½ tsp garlic powder 1 tsp onion powder ¾ tsp smoked paprika ¾ tsp salt ½ tsp black pepper ¼ tsp red pepper flakes (optional) ¼ cup fresh parsley, finely chopped Directions 1. Preheat oven to 400°F 2. Add chicken thigh, 1 ½ cups uncooked rice, diced onion, red bell pepper, cherry tomatoes, spinach, and minced garlic directly to the baking dish. 3. Season with 2 tsp Italian seasoning, 1 ½ tsp garlic powder, 1 tsp onion powder, ¾ tsp smoked paprika, ¾ tsp salt, ½ tsp black pepper, and red pepper flakes if using. 4. Pour in 3 cups chicken broth and stir everything together until evenly combined and the rice is submerged. 5. Cover the baking dish tightly with foil and bake at 400°F for 45 minutes. 6. Remove the foil and add fresh parm and go back in the oven uncovered for another 15 mins at 400° 7. Finish with the remaining fresh parsley  Serve hot and enjoy! YALL COME EAT it’s my viral sausage tortellini. 🤤  This recipe has nearly 5 million views on TikTok, so I thought it was time for an official step-by-step.  1. Cook 1 bag of tortellini according to the package directions. Drain and set aside. 2. Add 2 packs of sliced andouille sausage and cook until browned and heated through. Remove the sausage and set aside. 3. In the same skillet, add 1 small finely chopped onion and cook until softened, about 3–4 minutes. Add 2 cloves minced garlic and cook for another 30 seconds. 4. Add 8–10 halved cherry tomatoes, 2 tablespoons chopped sun-dried tomatoes and 1 tablespoon tomato paste. Stir everything together and cook for 2–3 minutes. 5. Season with 1 teaspoon oregano, 1 teaspoon basil, 1 teaspoon parsley, 1 teaspoon smoked paprika, 1 teaspoon garlic powder and 1 teaspoon onion powder. Add salt and pepper to taste. 6. Pour in 1 cup heavy cream and stir to combine. Bring the sauce to a gentle simmer, then add ½ cup shredded Parmesan cheese. Stir until the Parmesan melts and the sauce becomes creamy. 7. Add 1 cup roughly chopped spinach and stir until wilted. 8. Add the cooked tortellini and browned andouille sausage back into the skillet. Toss everything together until the tortellini and sausage are completely coated in the creamy sauce. Cook for another 1–2 minutes. 9. Garnish with red chili flakes and additional Parmesan cheese, if desired. #viralrecipe #tortellini #easydinnerideas #pastarecipe #familymeal

Garlic Herb Grilled Chicken Bowl🍗🧄🍚🥗 Juicy Middle Eastern grilled chicken served with fluffy spicy rice, refreshing tabbouleh, and a smooth, spicy garlic cream sauce. Every bite is loaded with flavour🤌🏽 Macros Per Serving (6 Total) 650 Calories | 52g Protein | 59g Carbs | 22g Fat Ingredients (Makes 6) Middle Eastern Chicken - 1200g Raw Boneless Chicken Thighs - 2.5 Tsp Salt - 4 Tsp Garlic Powder - 3 Tsp Onion Powder - 4 Tsp Oregano - 3 Tsp Parsley - 4 Tsp Paprika - 3 Tsp Cumin - 30g Honey - 80-100g Tomato Paste  - 1 Lemon Juice  - 30g Olive Oil Golden Herb Rice - 300g Uncooked Basmati Rice (Cook this beforehand) - 20g Light Butter - 100g White Onion, finely chopped - 1 Tsp Salt - 3 Tsp Italian Herbs - 1.5 Tsp Turmeric - 1 Tsp Paprika - 1 Tsp Cumin Tabouleh Salad - 3 Cups Parsley, chopped - 300g Tomato, chopped and de-seeded - 150g Green Onion/Scallion, chopped - 15g Olive Oil - Lemon Juice - 1/2 Tsp Salt - 2 Tsp Sumac - 1 Tsp Chilli Flakes Spicy Garlic Sauce - 300g Low Fat Yogurt - 100g Light Mayo - 120g Chilli Garlic Sauce (Lee Kum Kee) - 1 Tsp Paprika  - 1 Tsp Onion Powder - 1/4 Cup Evaporated Milk 👨‍🍳 Cooking Instructions 1. Trim excess fat from chicken thighs. Add the Middle Eastern spice mix, honey, tomato paste, lemon juice and olive oil. Mix well and marinate. 2. Heat a pan over low heat. Add light butter and chopped onion, cook for 5 mins until softened. Stir in the seasoning and toast for 3-4 mins . Add cooked basmati rice, turn off the heat and mix until fluffy and golden. 3. In a bowl, combine chopped tomato, green onion, parsley, olive oil, seasoning and lemon juice. Mix well and refrigerate until ready to serve. 4. Spread the chicken on a lined sheet pan and oven bake at 200C / 400F for 20-25 mins, then broil/grill for 5 mins until golden and juicy. 5. While the chicken rests, whisk together yogurt, light mayo, chilli garlic sauce, seasonings and evaporated milk until smooth. 6. Serve with the spiced rice, fresh salad and garlic sauce. Cherry blossoms are among the most beautiful and admired flowers in the world. Known for their soft pink and white petals, these delicate blooms appear during the spring season and symbolize renewal, hope, beauty, and the short but meaningful nature of life. Cherry blossom trees, often called sakura in Japan, have become deeply connected to culture, art, poetry, and traditions across many countries. Every year, millions of people gather in parks, gardens, and streets to witness the brief but breathtaking blooming season that transforms landscapes into seas of pink and white. Cherry blossoms bloom for only a short period, usually lasting one to two weeks depending on weather conditions. This short life span is one reason they are so admired. Their beauty reminds people that life itself is temporary and precious. In Japanese culture, cherry blossoms represent the idea of living in the moment and appreciating beauty while it lasts. Festivals called hanami, meaning “flower viewing,” are held during the blooming season. Families and friends gather beneath the trees for picnics, music, laughter, and celebration while enjoying the falling petals drifting through the air like soft pink snow. The history of cherry blossoms dates back thousands of years. In ancient Japan, emperors and nobles admired the blossoms and wrote poetry inspired by them. Over time, the tradition spread throughout society and eventually became known around the world. Today, cherry blossom festivals are celebrated in many countries including the United States, South Korea, and China. One of the most famous celebrations outside Japan takes place in Washington, D.C., where thousands of cherry blossom trees bloom around the Tidal Basin each spring. These trees were gifted by Japan in 1912 as a symbol of friendship between nations.#fyp #fyp #fypシ゚viral #foryou #japan

Notice the GarlicDalek T did you? 😏😂 Follow the link in my bio for the link 💪❤️ HIGH PROTEIN HONEY GARLIC BUTTER CHICKEN MAC & CHEESE 9.5/10 — bloody lovely. 😂 Creamy, cheesy mac & cheese with sticky honey garlic chicken. Absolute filth, but somehow still 59g of protein per serving. WHAT YOU’LL NEED: Honey Garlic Chicken • 800g chicken breast, cubed • 1.5 tsp salt • 1 tsp black pepper • 1 tsp chilli flakes • 1.5 tsp garlic powder • 1.5 tsp onion powder • 1.5 tsp smoked paprika • 2 tsp olive oil • 30g light butter • 2 tsp minced garlic • 30g honey • Handful fresh parsley, chopped Garlic Mac & Cheese • 220g uncooked macaroni • 1 large tbsp minced garlic • 300ml skimmed milk • 160g light cream cheese • 1 tsp salt • ½ tsp black pepper • 1 tsp smoked paprika • ½ tsp nutmeg • 100g low-fat cheddar cheese HOW TO MAKE IT: 1. Season the chicken with salt, black pepper, chilli flakes, garlic powder, onion powder and smoked paprika. 2. Heat a pan over medium heat with the olive oil and some of the butter. Add the chicken and cook for 4–5 minutes until golden, flip and cook for another 3–4 minutes until cooked through. 3. Lower the heat and add the remaining butter, minced garlic and honey. Give it a mixy mixy motherfucker! until the chicken is coated in that sticky honey garlic goodness. Remove and set aside. 4. Cook the macaroni according to the packet instructions. 5. In the same pan, cook the minced garlic in the leftover buttery goodness for around 2 minutes. 6. Add the skimmed milk, light cream cheese, salt, black pepper, smoked paprika and nutmeg. Stir until smooth. 7. Lower the heat, add the cheddar and stir until melted. Add the cooked macaroni and give the whole thing another mixy mixy motherfucker! 8. Serve the mac & cheese topped with the sticky honey garlic chicken and finish with fresh parsley. MACROS PER SERVING: 597 Calories | 59g Protein | 52g Carbs | 16g Fat SERVINGS: 4 Cheers: @jalalsamfit

I did NOT come up with this… but whoever did? You’re a genius 🤯 These are hands down one of the most incredible cookies I’ve ever made. I still can’t believe they’re made from just bananas and coconut flakes. That’s it. Soft, chewy, naturally sweet… and that chocolate topping? Don’t skip it. Trust me. Gluten-free, dairy-free, and just perfection ✨ Ingredients: • 2 ripe bananas • 2 cups unsweetened coconut flakes • Optional: 1 cup semi-sweet non-dairy chocolate chips • 1 tbsp coconut oil (or any neutral oil) Instructions: Mash the bananas in a bowl. Add the coconut flakes and mix until fully combined. Line a baking sheet with parchment paper. Scoop spoonfuls of the mixture onto the sheet. Using the back of a spoon, gently flatten and create a small well in the center of each cookie. Bake in a preheated oven at 350°F for 12–15 minutes. While they bake, melt the chocolate chips with the coconut oil until smooth. Once the cookies come out of the oven, spoon the melted chocolate into each center. Place in the fridge or freezer until the chocolate sets. I store mine in the freezer and eat them straight from there… they’re honestly perfect that way. These are amazing to make ahead and keep on hand 🙌 #sivanskitchen #coconut #cookie #easy #recipe

Creamy Chipotle Chicken & Potatoes🍗🍟🧀 One of the most indulgent meal prep recipes, so creamy, rich in flavour and packed with protein. Using a sheet pan is a game changer for batch cooking🔥 Macros Per Serving (6 Total) 548 Calories | 51g Protein | 52g Carbs | 17g Fat Ingredients (Makes 6 Servings) Chipotle Chicken Marinade - 1200g Raw Boneless Chicken Thighs, trim excess fat - 2.5 Tsp Salt - 3 Tsp Parsley - 3 Tsp Garlic Powder - 3 Tsp Smoked Paprika - 2.5 Tsp Cumin - 3 Tsp Onion Powder - 100g Chipotle Paste - 1 and 1/2 Limes, juiced - 30g or 6 Tsp Olive Oil Let this marinate overnight if possible, way more flavor! Crispy Seasoned Potatoes - 1300g Raw Yellow Potatoes, cubed - 2.5 Tsp Garlic Powder - 3 Tsp Italian Herbs - 3 Tsp Smoked Paprika - 2.5 Tsp Onion Powder - Avocado Cooking Spray, heavy pass Creamy Chipotle Sauce - 20g Light Butter - 150-200g Red Onion, finely chopped - 1.5 Tsp Salt - 2 Tsp Italian Herbs - 60-80g Chipotle Paste (depends how spicy you want it) - 400g Light Evaporated Milk - 110g Light Cream Cheese - Freshly Chopped Parsley, garnish 👨‍🍳 Cooking Instructions 1. Trim excess fat from chicken thighs. Add seasonings, chipotle paste, lime juice, and olive oil. Mix well and marinate. 2. Heat a large pan on low, add butter and chopped red onion. Cook for 5-7 mins until softened and lightly browned. Add seasonings and chipotle paste, mix, and cook for another 5 mins until caramelised. 3. Keep the heat low, add evaporated milk and cream cheese. Stir continuously until smooth, rich, and creamy. 4. Cube up potatoes, add seasoning and cooking spray, then mix well. Spread on a lined sheet pan and roast at 200C / 390F for 25 mins until golden and crispy. Season with salt, then fold into the sauce with fresh parsley until fully coated. 5. Spread marinated chicken on sheet pan, oven bake 25 mins 200C / 390F until golden and juicy. Cut into cubes, serve with creamy potatoes and ENJOY! . . . . #chipotle #chipotlechicken #highprotein #mealprep #healthyrecipes

Viral Pepperoni Pizza Caesar Wrap Recipe 🍕 made this wrap for dinner and my family enjoy it! It’s like having a pizza and a Caesar salad together but without the carbs☺️ Makes 2 wraps Ingredients For the Cheese Wraps * 1½ cups freshly grated part-skim low-moisture mozzarella cheese * 14–16 pepperoni slices * sprinkle with oregano and red pepper flakes For the Caesar Salad * 1 head romaine lettuce * ¼ cup crushed croutons * Extra parmesan cheese, for topping For the Caesar Dressing * ¼ cup Best Foods mayonnaise * ¼ cup 0% Greek yogurt * Juice from ½ lemon * 2 tsp Worcestershire sauce * 1½ tsp Dijon mustard * 1 large garlic clove, grated * ¼ cup grated parmesan cheese * ¼–½ tsp black pepper Directions 1. Preheat oven to 375°F. 2. Line a baking sheet with parchment paper. Spread ¾ cup freshly grated part-skim low-moisture mozzarella into a thin tortilla-sized circle. Top each with 7–8 pepperoni slices and sprinkle with the oregano and red pepper flakes. 3. Bake for 10-12 minutes or until crispy around the edges and golden brown. 4. Slice the romaine lettuce lengthwise, chop into thin strips, rinse under cold water, and dry very well using a salad spinner. 5. In a bowl, mix together the mayonnaise, Greek yogurt, lemon juice, Worcestershire sauce, Dijon mustard, garlic, parmesan, and black pepper. 6. Toss the romaine with most of the dressing, crushed croutons, and parmesan cheese. 7. Let the wraps cool slightly, then fill with the Caesar salad. Top with extra parmesan, croutons, and dressing if desired. #dinnerideas #easydinners #caesarsalad #pizza #wrap

Nashville Hot Chicken x Garlic Bread🔥 Crispy double-dredged Nashville hot chicken, with melty mozzarella, pickles, and homemade ranch, all packed onto garlic bread 😮‍💨 this thing will disappear FAST Garlic butter: 4 tbsp butter, softened 3 cloves garlic, minced 1 tbsp chopped parsley Chicken: 3 chicken thighs 3/4 cup flour 1/4 cup cornstarch 1 tsp paprika 1 tsp garlic powder 1/2 tsp cayenne 1/2 tsp salt 2 eggs, beaten 4 cups oil, for frying Nashville hot sauce: 1/2 cup hot oil, reserved from frying the chicken 2 tbsp cayenne pepper 1 tbsp brown sugar 1 tsp paprika 1 tsp garlic powder 1/2 tsp chili powder 1/2 tsp salt Ranch: 1/2 cup mayo 1/2 cup sour cream 1 tbsp fresh lemon juice 1 tsp dried dill 1 tsp dried parsley 1/2 tsp garlic powder 1/2 tsp onion powder 1/2 tsp salt 1/4 tsp black pepper To build: 1/2 loaf French or Italian bread 1 cup shredded mozzarella Sliced sweet pickles Steps 1.  Whisk flour, cornstarch, paprika, garlic powder, cayenne, and salt in a bowl. Beat eggs separately. 2.  Whisk mayo, sour cream, lemon juice, dill, parsley, garlic powder, onion powder, salt, and pepper for the ranch. 3.  Heat oil to 350°F in a deep pot or skillet. Dredge chicken in the flour mix, then egg wash, then flour mix again for a double coating. 4.  Fry until golden and 165°F internal, about 4-5 min. Drain on a rack. Save 1/2 cup oil for the Hot Oil 5.  Whisk the reserved hot oil with cayenne, brown sugar, paprika, garlic powder, chili powder, and salt. Toss the fried chicken in the sauce. 6.  Preheat oven to 400°F. Spread garlic butter evenly on the split loaf. 7.  Top with mozzarella. Bake 5-6 min until fully melted. 8. Cream chicken over biscuits with loaded bacon green beans! Such an easy comfort food dinner, and the homemade gravy is so good. I served mine over mashed potatoes with Cheddar Bay Biscuits on the side, but you can serve it right over the biscuits, too! Cream Chicken Over Biscuits Recipe Ingredients: 1 rotisserie chicken, shredded 2 tbsp butter 2 tbsp all purpose flour 2 cups water or chicken broth 1 tsp chicken bouillon Cheddar Bay Biscuits, prepared according to package instructions Mashed potatoes, for serving Seasonings: Dried parsley Garlic powder Onion powder Poultry seasoning Paprika Directions: Melt the butter in a pot over medium heat. Add the flour and stir well, letting it cook for about 2 minutes. Pour in the water or chicken broth and stir until smooth. Season to taste with parsley, garlic powder, onion powder, poultry seasoning, and paprika. Stir in the chicken bouillon and give everything a good stir. I skipped adding salt because the bouillon was salty enough! Let the gravy simmer for a few minutes, stirring occasionally, until it starts to thicken. Add the shredded rotisserie chicken and stir until everything is combined. Cover and let simmer for several minutes until the chicken is heated through and the gravy thickens to your liking. Prepare the Cheddar Bay Biscuits according to the package instructions. Serve the chicken gravy over mashed potatoes with biscuits on the side, or spoon it right over the biscuits! Loaded Bacon Green Beans Recipe Ingredients: 2 cans green beans, drained 2 slices thick cut bacon, chopped 1 tbsp butter 2 tbsp brown sugar 2 tbsp low sodium soy sauce Garlic powder Black pepper Directions: Cook the chopped bacon in a skillet over medium heat until crispy. Leave the bacon and bacon grease in the pan, then add the butter, drained green beans, brown sugar, soy sauce, garlic powder, and black pepper. Stir everything together, cover, and cook over medium heat, stirring occasionally, while you prepare the rest of dinner. Let the flavors come together until the green beans are tender! Save this one for your next weeknight dinner! #EasyDinnerIdeas #DinnerRecipes #WeeknightDinner #DinnerIdeas #EasyRecipe

باودر * ملعقة صغيرة فانيليا * نصف كوب قهوة حارة طريقة التحضير: في وعاء نحط المكونات الجافة مع بعض، اللي هي الدقيق والسكر والكاكاو والملح والبيكنج باودر وبيكربونات الصوديوم، ونخلطهم زين لين تتوزع المكونات مع بعض. بعدها نضيف المكونات السائلة، اللي هي اللبن والزيت والبيضة والفانيليا، ونحرّكهم لين نحصل على خليط ناعم ومتجانس. بعد ما نخلط المكونات مع بعض، نضيف نصف كوب قهوة حارة ونحرّك لين تمتزج تمامًا مع الخليط ويصير قوامه ناعم وسائل شوي. نجهّز قالب الكيك ونبطّنه بورق الزبدة، وبعدها نصب فيه خليط الكيك ونوزّعه بالتساوي. ندخل الكيك الفرن على درجة حرارة 180 لمدة 40 دقيقة تقريبًا، أو لين يستوي تمامًا، ونتأكد من استوائه باستخدام عود خشبي. بعد ما يستوي الكيك نطلّعه من الفرن ونتركه يبرد تمامًا قبل ما نبدأ بإضافة الحشوة والكريمة. كريمة البريجاديرو : * 115 جرام حليب مكثف محلى * 75 جرام كريمة خفق * 42 الى 55 جرام شوكولاتة خام * 4 جرام زبدة طريقة التحضير: في قدر على النار نحط الحليب المكثف المحلى وكريمة الخفق والزبدة، ونحرّكهم باستمرار لين يسخن الخليط ويبدأ يغلي،نصب الخليط وهو حار على الشوكولاتة، ونحرّكهم زين لين تذوب الشوكولاتة تمامًا ويصير عندنا خليط ناعم ومتجانس. نترك القناش يبرد شوي، وبعدها ندخله الثلاجة لين يبدأ يتماسك ويثقل قوامه. ولو نبغى نسرّع التبريد، نجهّز حمام ثلجي، نحط وعاء القناش داخل وعاء أكبر فيه ثلج، ونستمر بالتحريك لين يصير قوامه كثيف وكريمي وناعم. كريمة السحاب البيضاء : * 100 جرام حليب مكثف محلى بارد * 150 جرام كريمة خفق باردة * 40 جرام حليب بودرة * 35 جرام جبن كريمي * 5 جرام فانيليا طريقة التحضير: في وعاء الخفّاق نحط الجبن الكريمي والفانيليا، ونخفقهم مع بعض لين يصير القوام ناعم وكريمي ، بعدها نضيف الحليب المكثف المحلى وكريمة الخفق والحليب البودرة، ونستمر بالخفق لين يثقل القوام وتصير عندنا كريمة كثيفة وناعمة ومتماسكة. طريقة التقديم: قطعة من كيكة الشوكولاتة المحشية بالقناش في صحن التقديم، ونغطيها بكمية وفيرة من كريمة السحاب البيضاء، بحيث تنزل الكريمة على الأطراف وتغطي الكيكة بشكل جميل. وأخيرًا نرش على الوجه طبقة خفيفة من الحليب البودرة، ونقدمها بالعافية 🤍

Creamy Peri Peri Chicken Pasta🍗🧀🍝 Another game changing sheet pan meal prep. This pasta tastes unreal, low effort, easy to make for the week!🤌🏽🔥 Macros Per Serving (8 Total) 592 Calories | 55g Protein | 54g Carbs | 19g Fat Ingredients (Makes 8 Servings) Peri Peri Chicken - 1500g Raw Boneless Skinless Chicken Thighs, fat trimmed - 3 Tsp Salt - 2 Tsp Chilli Flakes - 4 Tsp Oregano - 4 Tsp Garlic Powder - 4 Tsp Smoked Paprika - 3 Tsp Onion Powder - 2 Tbsp Freshly Chopped Parsley - 2 Tbsp Freshly Chopped Coriander/Cilantro - 1 Lemon Juiced - 8 Tsp Olive Oil - 100g Nando’s Peri Peri Medium Sauce (used to brush over the chicken before cooking) - Avocado Cooking Spray (4 Tsp worth) Creamy Peri Peri Pasta - 200-250g White & Red Onion, chopped - 200-250g Red & Green Bell Pepper, chopped - 1.5 Tsp Salt - 2 Tsp Garlic Powder - 2 Tsp Oregano - 2 Tsp Smoked Paprika - 120-150g Tomato Paste - 180g Light Cream Cheese - 400ml Light Evaporated Milk - 150g Peri Peri Medium Sauce - 480g Uncooked Protein Rigatoni Pasta / ~800-900g Cooked Pasta - Fresh Chopped Parsley 👨‍🍳 Instructions 1. Trim excess fat from the chicken thighs. Add seasoning, fresh parsley and coriander, lemon juice, and olive oil. Mix until evenly coated and let marinate if time allows. 2. Line a sheet pan and spread the marinated chicken in a single layer. Brush with peri peri sauce and lightly spray with avocado oil. Bake in a preheated oven at 200C / 400F for 22-25 minutes until golden and juicy. While it cooks, boil the pasta, drain, and set aside. 3. Remove the chicken and keep all the pan juices. Add chopped onion and bell pepper, toss in the juices, spread flat, and roast at 180C / 370F for 15 minutes until soft and lightly charred. 4. While pan is hot, add extra seasoning, tomato paste, cream cheese, milk, peri peri sauce. Mix gently until melted creamy - the residual heat will help emulsify sauce. If needed, return to oven for 5 minutes. 5. Stir in cooked pasta and parsley until coated. Slice peri peri chicken, serve over pasta, and ENJOY! . . . #periperichicken #healthyrecipes #pasta #mealprep #sheetpandinner

Creamy Garlic Butter Chicken & Rice This Creamy Garlic Butter Chicken & Rice is a cozy, comforting dinner featuring juicy golden chicken served over fluffy rice with a rich, buttery Parmesan garlic sauce. It's simple enough for busy weeknights but delicious enough to feel like a special homemade meal. Ingredients • 1 1/2 pounds chicken tenderloins • 3 cups cooked white rice • 2 tablespoons olive oil • 3 tablespoons butter • 4 cloves garlic, minced • 1 cup chicken broth • 1 cup heavy cream • 1/2 cup grated Parmesan cheese • 1 teaspoon Italian seasoning • 1/2 teaspoon paprika • 1/2 teaspoon onion powder • Salt and black pepper, to taste • 1 tablespoon chopped fresh parsley Instructions Season the chicken with paprika, Italian seasoning, onion powder, salt, and black pepper. Heat the olive oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat. Cook the chicken for 4 to 5 minutes per side until golden brown and fully cooked. Transfer to a plate. Reduce the heat to medium and melt the butter in the same skillet. Add the garlic and sauté for about 30 seconds until fragrant. Pour in the chicken broth and stir, scraping up the browned bits from the bottom of the pan. Add the heavy cream and let the sauce simmer gently for 2 to 3 minutes. Whisk in the Parmesan cheese until the sauce is smooth and creamy. Return the chicken to the skillet and spoon the sauce over the top. Simmer for another 2 minutes. Serve the chicken over warm cooked rice and drizzle generously with the creamy garlic butter sauce. Finish with fresh parsley and extra Parmesan if desired. Prep Time: 10 minutes | Cook Time: 25 minutes | Total Time: 35 minutes Servings: 6 | Calories: About 620 per serving #dinner #easyrecipes #chicken #comfortfood #rice

Çıtır Peynir Topları (Crispy Cheese Balls) 😋 Ev yapımı lezzetlerin en kolayı ve en sevileni! Sadece 3 temel malzeme ile dışı çıtır, içi akışkan, uzadıkça uzayan harika bir atıştırmalık hazırlayabilirsiniz. 😍 Malzemeler: 1 adet taze yumurta 350g kaliteli rendelenmiş kaşar (veya mozzarella peyniri) 3 dolu yemek kaşığı nişasta Hazırlanışı: Tüm malzemeleri derin ve temiz bir kaba alarak, tamamen bütünleşip pürüzsüz bir hamur dokusuna ulaşana kadar güzelce yoğurun. Hamurdan ceviz büyüklüğünde, pürüzsüz parçalar koparıp yuvarlayın. Hazırladığınız topları kızgın yağda, her tarafı altın sarısı bir renk alana kadar kımkar kadar kontrollü bir şekilde kızartın. Sıcak ve taze bir şekilde servis edin! (Püf Noktası: Yağınızın ideal sıcaklıkta olması kritik önem taşır; böylece peynirler dışarı sızmadan hemen mühürlenir ve çıtırlaşır!) 📌 Bu tarifi denemek için kaydetmeyi ve sevdiklerinizle paylaşmayı unutmayın! English Version (Ingredients & Instructions): Ingredients: 1 fresh egg 350g grated quality kashar cheese (or mozzarella) 3 heaping tablespoons cornstarch Preparation: Place all ingredients in a deep bowl and knead thoroughly until you achieve a homogeneous, dough-like consistency. Break off uniform pieces the size of a walnut and form them into smooth balls. Fry the balls in a pan of properly pre-heated oil until they are crisp and a rich golden brown on all sides. Serve immediately for best results! (Pro-Tip: Ensuring the oil is at the correct high temperature is essential; this instantly forms a crispy crust and prevents the cheese from leaking out!) 📌 Don’t forget to bookmark this recipe to try and share it with your friends and family! #tarif #kaşar #pratiktarifler #keşfetteyiz #cheese

Creamy Chicken in 20 Minutes! Weeknights can get a little hectic, and sometimes you just need something quick and easy for dinner! Nothing beats a good chicken dinner, especially when it looks and tastes like something you’d order at a nice Italian restaurant! The best part is you don’t have to spend hours in the kitchen to make something this good. Pollo alla Valdostana Ingredients 1 lb (450 g) thin chicken cutlets 1/4 lb (115 g) prosciutto cotto (Italian cooked ham) 1/3 lb (150 g) Fontina cheese, shredded 1/2 cup white wine 1/2 cup chicken or vegetable broth (plus an extra 1/2 cup for more sauce) Flour Extra virgin olive oil Knob of butter Salt and pepper Fresh parsley Instructions 1. Heat olive oil and a knob of butter in a pan over medium-high heat. 2. While the butter melts, lightly flour the chicken cutlets and place them directly into the pan. 3. Cook for about 2 minutes per side, seasoning with salt and pepper. 4. Add the white wine and let it reduce for a minute or two. 5. Pour in the broth, then top each cutlet with prosciutto cotto, Fontina cheese, and fresh parsley. 6. Cover and simmer until the chicken is cooked through, the cheese melts, and the sauce thickens. #chicken #easyrecipe #fyp

Marry Me Chicken 🍅✨ A classic dinner idea made a little lighter and packed with protein! This meal is made in one pan and comes together in about 30 minutes. It's the perfect comfort food meal while also helping you hit your protein goals! Makes 4 servings. 4 small chicken breasts (or 2 large cut in half) 1 tbsp olive oil 1 tsp Italian seasoning ½ tsp paprika ½ tsp garlic powder Salt and black pepper, to taste 3 cloves garlic, minced ¾ cup low-sodium chicken broth ⅓ cup chopped sun-dried tomatoes, drained 1 cup low-fat cottage cheese ½ cup fat-free milk ½ cup freshly grated Parmesan cheese 2 cups fresh spinach Fresh basil, for garnish 1. Blend the cottage cheese and fat-free milk until completely smooth and creamy. 2. Season the chicken with the Italian seasoning, paprika, garlic powder, salt, and pepper. 3. Heat the olive oil in a large skillet over medium heat. Cook the chicken for 4 minutes per side until golden. Transfer to a plate. 4. Reduce the heat to low-medium and cook the garlic for about 30 seconds until fragrant. 5. Pour in the chicken broth, scraping up any browned bits from the pan. Stir in the sun-dried tomatoes and simmer for 2-3 minutes. 6. Remove the skillet from the heat and let cool for about five minutes. 7. Slowly whisk the cottage cheese mixture into the skillet until smooth. (Make sure tomato mixture is cool enough before adding the cottage cheese to prevent curdling!) 8. Add the spinach and cook until wilted. Add Parmesan and mix until melted. 9. Return the chicken to the skillet and warm over low heat for 3-4 minutes. Garnish with fresh basil and enjoy! Serve over pasta, rice, vegetables or bread. #marrymechicken #easydinnerideas #onepanmeal

✨ Cheesy Meat-Stuffed Breakfast Biscuits ✨ A delicious, flaky, and cheese-packed comfort food recipe featuring golden-brown biscuits stuffed with savory ground meat and melted cheese. 🍴 Ingredients: - 1 package refrigerated biscuit dough or homemade biscuit dough - 1 lb ground beef or sausage, cooked and seasoned - 1.5 cups shredded cheddar cheese - 2 tbsp melted butter - 1 tsp garlic powder - Fresh parsley, finely chopped for garnish - Salt and freshly cracked black pepper to taste 👩🏽‍🍳 Instructions: 1. Preheat your oven to 350°F (175°C) and line a baking sheet with parchment paper. 2. Separate the biscuit dough, flatten each piece slightly, and place a spoonful of cooked meat and a generous amount of shredded cheese in the center. 4. Fold the dough securely around the filling to form stuffed biscuit balls or rounds, pinching the edges to seal. 5. Arrange the stuffed biscuits on the prepared baking sheet. 6. Brush the tops with melted butter and sprinkle a little extra cheese or parsley on top. 7. Bake in the preheated oven for 15 to 18 minutes until the biscuits are golden brown and cooked through. 8. Cozy Dinner Idea 🤎 Creamy Chicken Marsala 🍄 INGREDIENTS For the Chicken: • 2 large chicken breasts, sliced horizontally into 4 cutlets • Kinder’s Grilled Chicken Seasoning • Salt, to taste • ½ cup all-purpose flour • 2 tbsp olive oil • 2 tbsp unsalted butter For the Marsala Sauce: • 8 oz baby bella mushrooms, sliced • 1 shallot, finely diced • 3–4 garlic cloves, minced • ¾ cup Marsala cooking wine • ¾ cup chicken broth • ½ cup heavy cream • 3–4 sprigs fresh thyme • Salt & black pepper, to taste • 1 tbsp butter (optional, for finishing) • Fresh parsley, for garnish INSTRUCTIONS 1. Season chicken cutlets on both sides with salt and Kinder’s Grilled Chicken Seasoning. Lightly coat each piece in flour, shaking off any excess. 2. Heat olive oil and butter in a large skillet over medium-high heat. Sear chicken for 4–5 minutes per side until golden brown. Remove and set aside. 3. In the same skillet, add sliced mushrooms to the remaining butter, oil, and chicken drippings. Sauté for 5–7 minutes until golden brown. 4. Add diced shallots and cook for 2 minutes. Stir in minced garlic and fresh thyme, cooking for another 30 seconds until fragrant. 5. Pour in Marsala cooking wine, scraping up all those flavorful browned bits from the bottom of the skillet. Simmer for 3–5 minutes until reduced by half. 6. Add chicken broth and simmer for another 3–4 minutes. Reduce heat to medium-low, stir in heavy cream, and let the sauce gently simmer until slightly thickened. 7. Return chicken and any juices to the skillet. Spoon the creamy mushroom sauce over the chicken and simmer for 3–5 minutes, or until the chicken reaches 165°F internally. 8. Remove thyme stems, stir in a tablespoon of butter if desired for a silky finish, and garnish with fresh parsley. #ChickenMarsala #DinnerIdeas #EasyDinnerRecipes #QuickDinner #CozyDinner

My sister-in-law’s famous Thanksgiving mashed potatoes 🥔 I’m also releasing a completely free Thanksgiving cookbook with recipes for every staple Thanksgiving dish you need for the big day. Everything is easy and doable without sacrificing flavor. Coming very soon, so follow my page so you don’t miss it Ingredients • 5 lb Yukon gold potatoes • 16 oz cream cheese, softened • ⅓ cup sour cream • ½ cup milk • 1 stick butter, softened, plus extra slices for topping • 1 tsp black pepper • 2 tsp salt • Paprika, for topping • 1 bunch fresh chives, chopped Instructions 1. Set out the cream cheese and butter to soften. Preheat the oven to 400°F. 2. Boiling Method: Peel the potatoes and cut into evenly sized chunks. Place in a large pot, cover with cold water, and bring to a boil. Reduce to a simmer and cook for 15–20 minutes, or until fork-tender. 3. Instant Pot Method (Alternative): Add 1 cup of water to the Instant Pot and place the trivet inside. Add the whole, unpeeled potatoes. Pressure cook on high for 14 minutes, then allow a 10-minute natural pressure release before releasing the remaining pressure. Carefully remove, cool slightly, and peel. Cook in batches if necessary. 4. Transfer cooked potatoes to a large mixing bowl. Add cream cheese, sour cream, milk, butter, salt, and pepper. 5. Use a hand mixer or stand mixer to mix until smooth and creamy, being careful not to overmix. 6. Transfer to a greased 9×13-inch baking dish and spread evenly. 7. Sprinkle paprika over the top and add a few thin slices of butter. 8. Cover tightly with aluminum foil. 9. Bake at 400°F for 60 minutes, or until heated through. 10. Remove the foil during the final 5 minutes to lightly brown the top. 11. Sprinkle the freshly chopped chives over the top before serving. Make-Ahead Instructions 1. Prepare the mashed potatoes following steps 1–8 above, using either cooking method. Wait to preheat the oven until you’re ready to bake. 2. Cover tightly with foil and refrigerate for up to 2 days. 3. Remove from the refrigerator 30 minutes before baking. 4. Preheat oven to 400°F. 5. Bake covered for approximately 60 minutes, until hot in the center. 6. Remove foil for the final 5 minutes to lightly brown the top. 7. Sprinkle with the chopped chives before serving. #mashedpotatoes #EasyRecipe

Mix together all of your Cajun seasoning. 2. Season the diced chicken generously with about ⅔ of the seasoning. 3. Heat olive oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat. Add the chicken and cook for 3–4 minutes until browned on the outside but not completely cooked through. 4. Add the onion and bell pepper and cook for another 2–3 minutes. Add the garlic and cook for about 30 seconds. 5. Add the uncooked pasta, chicken broth and remaining Cajun seasoning. Stir everything together and bring to a gentle boil. 6. Reduce heat to medium-low, cover and cook for 10–13 minutes, stirring every few minutes so the pasta doesn’t stick. 7. Cook until the pasta is al dente and most of the liquid has been absorbed. 8. Reduce the heat to low and stir in the cream cheese and Parmesan until everything comes together into a thick, creamy Cajun sauce. 9. Sticky Honey Garlic Chicken & Peppers!!!  Tender chicken coated in a honey garlic soy sauce with sautéed peppers. Sticky, savory, and perfect over rice!!!  Honey Garlic Chicken & Peppers  2 large chicken breast  Neutral oil  1/2 tsp salt 1/2 tsp black pepper  1 tsp soy 1/2 tsp onion powder  1 tsp cornstarch  Sauce  Bell peppers, sliced (for sautéing) 1 tsp ginger paste or grated  2 tbsp garlic paste  2 tbsp honey  1/4 cup light and dark soy combined  1 tsp rice seasoning  1 tbsp hoisin sauce  1/2 tbsp oyster sauce  1/2 tsp Totole Granulated Chicken Flavor Season the chicken with neutral oil, seasonings, and cornstarch. Marinate for at least 2 hours. Cook the chicken in a skillet 2–3 minutes per side until lightly browned, then remove and set aside. In the same pan, sauté the sliced peppers until they reach your desired texture, then add the garlic paste. Pour in the sauce and simmer for a few minutes, stirring occasionally. If needed, add a 1:1 cornstarch slurry to thicken. Return the chicken to the pan and toss everything together until coated. High protein, gut-healthy and paired with my daily Nature Made Probiotic + Prebiotic Fiber Gummies… weeknight approved 🫡 #partner For the Chicken: -1.5 lbs (680g) boneless, skinless chicken thighs -Seasoning: 1 tbsp smoked paprika, 1 tbsp chili powder, 2 tsp cumin, 2 tsp garlic powder, 2 tsp onion powder, 2 tsp oregano, 2 tsp salt, 1 tsp pepper -3 tbsp olive oil -6 garlic cloves, minced -1 lime, juiced For the Street Corn: -30 oz (850 g) corn kernels (or 4 cobs) -⅓ cup red onion, finely diced -1 fresh jalapeno, diced (deseeded) -½ avocado, cubed -¼ cup fresh cilantro, chopped -⅓ cup cotija cheese (or feta), crumbled -Seasonings: 2 tsp chile lime, 1 tsp salt, 1 tsp pepper -¼ cup greek yogurt -¼ cup mayonnaise -½ lime, juiced For the Aji Verde: -½ cup greek yogurt -½ cup mayonnaise  -1 small jalapeño, deseeded -1 1/2 cups cilantro, leaves and stems -4 to 5 garlic cloves -2 tsp black pepper -1 tsp salt -Juice of 1 lime Instructions: 1. In a bowl, combine the chicken with the spices, olive oil, garlic and lime juice. Mix well & marinate for as long as your patience can handle. 2. For even more flavor, char the corn in a hot skillet for 5–7 with a splash of neutral oil before mixing with the remaining street corn ingredients. Refrigerate. 3. To a food processor or blender, add all of the Aji Verde ingredients and blend until smooth & vibrant green. 4. I recommend making rice for the bowls! 2 cups of long grain white rice should do the trick. Once done, fluff with 2 tbsp olive oil, ¼ cup fresh cilantro and a splash of lime juice. 5. Heat a large pan over medium-high heat & add a drizzle of olive oil. Once hot, add the chicken in batches. Cook for 6 to 8 mins per side until golden & cooked through. Set aside. 6. Assemble your bowls with the rice, chicken, street corn salad, a generous drizzle of aji verde, extra cotija, and fresh cilantro. Enjoy :)

Take a moment and ask yourself: If it were someone you love—your daughter, your sister, your wife, or your mother—would you accept this as "tradition"? Let's raise awareness, start conversations, and stand together to end harmful practices like this. EASY RECIPE BELOW👇😋 𝐂𝐫𝐞𝐚𝐦𝐲 𝐒𝐦𝐨𝐭𝐡𝐞𝐫𝐞𝐝 𝐂𝐡𝐢𝐜𝐤𝐞𝐧 & 𝐑𝐢𝐜𝐞  …this one is PURE comfort food & so easy 🥹🍗🍚 the sauce is rich, herby, a little spice, and so good poured over fluffy rice!!🤍✨ ⸻ 𝐈𝐧𝐠𝐫𝐞𝐝𝐢𝐞𝐧𝐭𝐬: 𝐅𝐨𝐫 𝐭𝐡𝐞 𝐂𝐡𝐢𝐜𝐤𝐞𝐧: • 2 lbs chicken thighs or breasts • 1 tsp salt • ½ tsp black pepper • 1 tsp garlic powder • 1 tsp onion powder • 1 tsp paprika • 1 tsp dried thyme • 1 tsp dried parsley • 2 tbsp olive oil 𝐅𝐨𝐫 𝐭𝐡𝐞 𝐒𝐚𝐮𝐜𝐞: • 2 tbsp butter • 1 small onion, diced • 3 cloves garlic, minced • 2 cups chicken broth • 1 cup heavy cream • 1 tsp dried thyme • 1 tsp dried parsley • ½ tsp salt • ½ tsp black pepper • ½ tsp red pepper flakes • 1 tsp cornstarch + 1 tbsp water (optional to make it thicker) 𝐅𝐨𝐫 𝐭𝐡𝐞 𝐑𝐢𝐜𝐞: • 1½ cups long-grain white rice • 3 cups water or chicken broth ⸻  𝐈𝐧𝐬𝐭𝐫𝐮𝐜𝐭𝐢𝐨𝐧𝐬:  1. Season your chicken with salt, pepper, garlic powder, onion powder, paprika, thyme, and parsley. 2. Heat olive oil in a skillet and sear chicken 4–5 minutes per side until golden. Remove it and set aside with foil over it. 3. In the same pan, add olive oil. Add your diced onion and sauté about 3 minutes until soft. Keep stirring so it doesn’t burn. Then add butter & garlic and cook 30 seconds. 4. Pour in chicken broth to deglaze the pan. Stir in heavy cream, thyme, parsley, salt, pepper, and red pepper flakes. Simmer about 5 minutes. (Add cornstarch slurry if you want it thicker.) 5. Return chicken to the sauce. Cover and simmer on low 10–15 minutes until fully cooked and tender. 6. Cook rice separately… bring liquid to a boil, add rinsed rice, cover and cook about 15 minutes. Let sit 5 minutes, then fluff. 7. Serve chicken over rice and spoon extra creamy sauce on top 🤍 #easydinner #dinnerinspo #easyrecipes #chickenandrice #chickenrecipes

🍔 VIRAL GARLIC PARMESAN CHEESEBURGERS 🧄🧀 Don’t make regular cheeseburgers again until you try them served face down in a pool of creamy garlic Parmesan sauce! 😭🔥 Ingredients For the burgers: * 1 lb ground beef (80/20) * 1 small onion, thinly sliced * Salt, pepper, garlic powder & paprika * 4 slices American cheese * 4 burger buns * Butter for toasting For the garlic Parmesan sauce: * 2 tbsp butter * 4 cloves garlic, minced * 1 cup heavy cream * ½ cup freshly grated Parmesan * ½ tsp garlic powder * ½ tsp smoked paprika * ½ tsp Italian seasoning * Salt & pepper to taste * Fresh parsley Instructions 1. Make the smash burgers: Divide beef into 4 portions. Add sliced onions to a hot skillet, place beef on top and smash into thin patties. Season generously. 2. Get those crispy edges: Sear until browned, flip and cook to 160°F. Top with American cheese and let it melt. 3. Make the sauce: Melt butter in a saucepan, sauté garlic until fragrant, then add heavy cream and seasonings. Simmer gently before stirring in Parmesan until smooth and creamy. 4. Finish it off: Surround the burgers with crispy fries, garnish with parsley and serve immediately! Easy High Protein Honey BBQ Chicken Mac & Cheese🍯🍗🧀 59g Protein Meal Prep💪🏼 (Macros Per Serve, Makes 4 Servings) 587 Calories 67.5gC | 9gF | 59gP Like recipes like this? Check out my cookbooks! LINK IS IN MY BIO 👨🏻‍🍳📚 Ingredients: * 700g Diced Chicken Breast (raw weight) * 1 Tsp Each: Salt, Onion Powder, Smoked Paprika & Garlic Powder * 1 Tsp Olive Oil * 25g Honey * 85g Reduced Sugar or Sugar Free BBQ Sauce (Hughes Sugar Free BBQ Sauce or your preferred BBQ sauce) * 320g Macaroni Pasta (uncooked weight) * 340ml Fat Free Evaporated Milk (Carnation Light & Creamy 99% Fat Free) * 80g Light Cream Cheese * 1.5 Tsp Chicken Stock Powder * 100g Grated Light Cheddar Cheese (Dairyworks Natural Cheddar) Instructions: 1. Add the diced chicken breast to a bowl and season with salt, onion powder, smoked paprika & garlic powder. Drizzle over the olive oil and mix thoroughly until every piece is evenly coated in the seasonings. 2. Heat a pan over medium heat and add the seasoned chicken. Cook for approximately 4 minutes on each side or until golden on the outside and fully cooked through. 3. Reduce the heat to low, then add the honey and BBQ sauce directly to the pan. Toss the chicken through the sauce until every piece is coated in a thick & sticky honey BBQ glaze. Remove from the heat and set aside. 4. Meanwhile bring a pot of salted water to a boil and cook the macaroni according to the packet instructions until al dente. Drain the pasta and set aside. 5. For the cheese sauce add the evaporated milk, light cream cheese and chicken stock powder to a separate pan over medium low heat. Stir until the cream cheese has softened and combined with the milk then gradually add the grated cheddar. Continue stirring until melted into a smooth, rich & creamy cheese sauce. 6. Add the drained macaroni directly into the cheese sauce and mix everything together until the pasta is completely coated in that creamy, cheesy goodness. 7. Divide the honey BBQ chicken and mac & cheese evenly between 4 meal prep containers. Finish with some freshly chopped parsley if desired and enjoy! Meal Prep Pro Tip: Mac & Cheese naturally thickens as it cools because the pasta continues absorbing moisture from the sauce. When reheating add a small splash of milk and give everything a good stir to bring back that smooth, creamy consistency! Store in airtight containers in the fridge for up to 3 to 4 days, or freeze individual portions for longer storage. #macandcheese #mealprep #highprotein #healthyrecipes #chickenmacandcheese

Cross posting to 4 accounts has been a little crazy and ya girl needs a breather 😮‍💨 so enjoy! ☺️  ✨ Creamy Garlic Chicken & Mashed Potatoes 🤍🧄🥔 If comfort food had a personality, this would be it. Tender pan-seared chicken, creamy garlic parmesan gravy, and buttery mashed potatoes that soak up every last drop. ✨ 🕒 Total Time: ~45 minutes 🍽️ Serves: 4-6 📋 Ingredients: • 2 lbs chicken breasts, sliced in half lengthwise • 2 tbsp olive oil • 2 tbsp butter • 2 tbsp all-purpose flour • 1½ cups chicken broth • 1 cup heavy cream or half-and-half • ½ cup grated parmesan cheese • Garlic salt • Onion powder • Paprika • Black pepper • Mashed potatoes, for serving 👩🏼‍🍳 Directions: 1. Season chicken generously with garlic salt, onion powder, paprika, and black pepper. 2. Heat olive oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat. 3. Cook chicken 4-5 minutes per side until golden brown and cooked through. Remove from skillet and set aside. 4. Reduce heat to medium. Add butter to the skillet and let melt. 5. Whisk in flour and cook for 1-2 minutes to create a roux. 6. Slowly pour in chicken broth while whisking until smooth and thickened. 7. Stir in heavy cream (or half-and-half) and parmesan cheese. Simmer until the gravy is rich, creamy, and silky smooth. 8. Return the chicken to the skillet and spoon the sauce over top. Simmer for 3-5 minutes. 9. Serve over warm mashed potatoes and drizzle with plenty of that creamy garlic gravy. ✨ This is the kind of dinner that has everyone asking for seconds and a piece of bread to clean the plate. 🤍 #CreamyGarlicChicken #ComfortFood #EasyDinnerRecipe #FamilyDinner

VOLCÁN CHOCOLATE 👇receta escrita👇 CLICK @laura.lopez.mon para más recetas fáciles 💥GUÁRDATE💥 esta receta de pastel de chocolate | lava cake, facilísimo de hacer con 5 ingredientes, sin robots ¡nunca falla! ➖➖➖➖➖➖ 📍 INGREDIENTES 4 unidades 200 g chocolate (mínimo 55% de cacao) 70 g mantequilla 4 huevos M 70 g azúcar 50 g harina trigo común (sin levaduras) Para pincelar los moldes : mantequilla y cacao puro en polvo ➖➖➖➖➖➖ 📍ELABORACIÓN 🔹️ Pon en un recipiente el chocolate y la mantequilla y fúndelo. Deja atemperar 5 minutos 🔹️ Mientras pon en un bol los huevos y el azúcar y bate con unas varillas hasta que espumen. Añade el chocolate y mezcla con una espátula hasta que se integre por completo 🔹️ Añade la harina tamizada y mezcla con la espátula hasta que esté perfectamente integrado 🔹️ Pincela los moldes con mantequilla a punto de pomada y espolvorea con cacao en polvo 🔹️ Llena los moldes con la masa hasta 1 cm del borde. Introduce en el congelador 30 minutos 🔹️ Saca del congelador e introduce en el horno precalentado a 220°C durante 12 minutos ⚠️ la temperatura interior de tu horno puede variar respecto a la mía (cada horno es un mundo) por lo que el tiempo de cocción puede variar entre 12 y 15 minutos. Deberás probar variando los minutos hasta conseguir el punto, pero nunca será menos de 12 ni más de 15 🔹️ Saca del horno y deja reposar 2 minutos. Separa la pared con el fijo de un cuchillo y desmolda 🔹️ Sirve inmediatamente ➖➖➖➖➖➖➖ Feliz día 🤗 #lauralopezmon #lavacake #micuitchocolat #volcandechocolate #coulant

Cozy & Affordable Baked Chicken Dinner 🍗🤎 Tonight I was going for cozy, comforting, and affordable, and this is one of my go-to dinners when I want something simple but still really good. Ingredients: * Chicken legs * Olive oil * Garlic powder * Onion powder * Paprika * Seasoning salt * Black pepper * Italian seasoning * 1 orange bell pepper, sliced * 1 green bell pepper, sliced * 1 onion, sliced * 2 cans cream of mushroom soup * ½–1 cup chicken broth * Jasmine rice * French-style green beans * Buttermilk biscuits * Honey for glazing Instructions: 1. Season the chicken legs with garlic powder, onion powder, paprika, seasoning salt, black pepper, and Italian seasoning. 2. Drizzle with olive oil and mix well so the seasoning coats the chicken. 3. Slice the peppers and onion. 4. Sauté the peppers and onions in a skillet until they begin to soften. 5. Add the cream of mushroom soup and chicken broth. Stir until smooth and creamy. 6. Place the seasoned chicken in a baking dish and pour the creamy mixture over the top. 7. Bake at 375°F for about 50–60 minutes, or until the chicken reaches 165°F internally and is fully cooked. 8. Serve with jasmine rice, French-style green beans, and a warm buttermilk biscuit finished with a little honey. Affordable, filling, and the perfect comfort dinner. Save this one for later! 🤎 #BakedChicken #AffordableMeals #DinnerIdeas #ComfortFood #EasyRecipes

videos.caption: Butternut Chicken Mac & Cheese🔥538 cals 56g protein 12g fat 54g carbs Cookbook in bio 🔗 Ingredients: this makes 6 meals 1 medium butternut squash (24 oz after roasted) 32 oz boneless, skinless chicken breast (raw weight) 10 oz dry rigatoni 1 whole garlic bulb 1 small yellow onion 1 cup fat free cottage cheese 1½ cups reduced fat shredded sharp cheddar ½ cup mild cheddar ½ cup grated Parmesan ½ cup skim milk ½ cup bone broth no salt added 1 tbsp olive oil Seasoning blend: 1 tsp smoked paprika 1 tsp garlic powder 1 tsp onion powder ½ tsp salt ½ tsp black pepper Directions: 1.Preheat your oven to 400°F. Wash the butternut squash, slice it lengthwise, and scoop out the seeds. Place both halves cut-side up in a large baking dish. 2.Slice the top off the garlic bulb to expose the cloves. Place it in the baking dish alongside the squash, and add your quartered yellow onion. Drizzle everything with olive oil, then evenly cover with the seasonings. Cover the garlic bulb loosely with aluminum foil to prevent burning. 3.Bake uncovered for 50 - 60 minutes, or until the squash is completely fork tender. Loosely lay foil over the top if you notice onions begin to brown too quickly 4.While everything roasts, cook your chicken breast using your preferred method until it reaches an internal temperature of 165°F. Cook your rigatoni according to package instructions. 5.Once roasted, allow the squash to cool slightly. Add 24 oz of the roasted squash to a blender. Squeeze in the softened garlic cloves and add the roasted onion, cottage cheese, milk, and bone broth. Blend until completely smooth and creamy. 6.Pour the creamy butternut sauce back into your baking dish. Stir in shredded sharp cheddar and parm 7.Add your cooked shredded chicken and pasta directly into the sauce. Fold everything together until evenly coated. Top with freshly grated mild cheddar cheese and parm evenly over the top. 8.Return to the oven at 400°F for 10–15 minutes For a golden, cheesy crust, switch your oven to broil for an additional 1–3 minutes, watching closely.Remove from the oven, divide into 6 meals, and enjoy! Recipe Name Cheesy Sloppy Joe Garlic Toasts Ingredients 1. 1 French baguette, sliced into thick pieces 2. 1 lb ground beef 3. 1 small onion, finely diced 4. 2 garlic cloves, minced 5. 1 tbsp olive oil 6. 1/2 cup ketchup 7. 2 tbsp tomato paste 8. 1 tbsp Worcestershire sauce 9. 1 tsp yellow mustard 10. 1 tsp brown sugar 11. 1/2 tsp paprika 12. 1 tsp salt 13. 1/2 tsp black pepper 14. 2 cups shredded cheddar and mozzarella cheese blend 15. 2 tbsp butter, melted 16. 1 tsp dried parsley Recipe 1. Preheat the oven to 375°F (190°C). 2. Heat olive oil in a skillet and sauté the onion until softened. 3. Add the garlic and cook for 30 seconds. 4. Add the ground beef and cook until browned, breaking it into small crumbles. 5. Drain excess grease, then stir in ketchup, tomato paste, Worcestershire sauce, mustard, brown sugar, paprika, salt, and pepper. 6. Simmer the mixture for 5–7 minutes until thick. 7. Brush the bread slices with melted butter and place them on a baking sheet. 8. Spoon the beef mixture evenly onto each slice. 9. Top generously with the shredded cheese blend. 10. Bake for 10–12 minutes until the cheese is melted and bubbly. 11. Broil for 1–2 minutes for a golden finish if desired. 12. Sprinkle with dried parsley and serve hot. Sweet, savory, and packed with bold garlic flavor 🧄🍗 — this Garlic Brown Sugar Chicken is sticky, caramelized perfection and comes together fast! ⸻ 🍗 Garlic Brown Sugar Chicken ⭐ Ingredients 	•	4 boneless, skinless chicken breasts (or thighs) 	•	Salt & black pepper 	•	1 tsp paprika 	•	2 tbsp olive oil Garlic Brown Sugar Sauce: 	•	½ cup packed brown sugar 	•	4 cloves garlic, minced 	•	2 tbsp soy sauce 	•	1 tbsp Dijon mustard (optional, for depth) 	•	1 tbsp apple cider vinegar or lemon juice 	•	½ tsp crushed red pepper (optional) ⸻ 👩‍🍳 Directions 	1.	Season chicken: Pat chicken dry and season both sides with salt, pepper, and paprika. 	2.	Sear: Heat olive oil in a skillet over medium-high heat. Cook chicken 4–5 minutes per side until golden brown. 	3.	Make sauce: In a bowl, whisk together brown sugar, garlic, soy sauce, mustard, vinegar, and red pepper flakes. 	4.	Simmer: Reduce heat to medium-low. Pour sauce into skillet. Spoon sauce over chicken and simmer 5–7 minutes until sauce thickens and chicken is cooked through. 	5.	Serve: Spoon extra caramelized garlic sauce over top before serving. ⸻ 🍽️ Serve With 	•	White or jasmine rice 	•	Roasted broccoli 	•	Mashed potatoes ⸻ ✨ Tips 	•	Chicken thighs stay extra juicy 	•	For thicker sauce, simmer a few extra minutes 	•	Add a splash of pineapple juice for a sweet tropical twist Sticky, garlicky, and perfectly sweet — a guaranteed weeknight favorite 💛 #foodie #foodtok #recipe #dinner #chicken

videos.caption: Cheat code meal prep. This Mexican cheesy chicken and rice might be one of my all time favorites so far. Honestly… I totally outdid myself with this one. The flavor is unreal and each meal packs over 50 grams of protein to keep you full and on track. Here is how to make it. Pico de gallo 5 roma tomatoes 1 jalapeno 1 bunch cilantro Juice of 1 lime 1 white onion Salt, pepper, garlic powder Dice everything and mix together with the lime juice and seasonings. Chicken 3 pounds chicken 2 packets taco seasoning Juice of 1 lime 1 tablespoon avocado oil Cook the chicken in a pan on medium high heat with the avocado oil. Add taco seasoning and lime juice and cook until fully done. Mexican rice 1½ cups dry rice 3 cups water 3 tablespoons tomato paste Sazón seasoning 1 sweet onion Saute the onion first. Add the rice and lightly toast it. Then add the water, tomato paste, and sazón seasoning. Bring to a boil, cover, and cook on low for about 10 minutes. High protein queso 2 cups low fat cottage cheese 2 cups shredded jalapeno cheddar 2 tablespoons diced green onion Diced green chili pepper Splash of lime juice Milk to thin Blend the cottage cheese until smooth, then heat with the shredded cheese, green onion, green chili, lime juice, and a little milk until it becomes a creamy queso. Layer the chicken, rice, pico, and drizzle the high protein queso on top. Big flavor. High protein. Perfect for meal prep. Cleaning a fish tank doesn't always mean draining it. In this method, waste and debris are removed while the water stays in place. Tools like siphon vacuums and filtration systems pull out uneaten food, algae, and sediment from the gravel, keeping the environment clean without stressing the fish. What makes this approach effective is balance. Beneficial bacteria remain undisturbed, water chemistry stays stable, and the tank continues to cycle naturally. artist and automata maker Amedeo Capelli, known as Stoccafisso Design, creates playful mechanical sculptures from wood, wire and simple mechanisms. In his recent shrimp automata, a handmade crustacean comes to life through a system of wooden gears, cams, rods and rotating parts hidden beneath the stage. Turning the crank transfers motion through the mechanism, making the shrimp’s body and limbs move in an exaggerated, almost theatrical way. Capelli’s work combines traditional automata-making, kinetic sculpture and humor. Instead of hiding the mechanics, he often leaves them visible, allowing us to understand how a simple rotation can be transformed into surprisingly complex movement. #shrimp #art #artist #niche #weird
